A crafted Epic from Common loot costs about 1H L50 2,240g / 2H L50 3,364g + Essences, roughly half the shop Epic price (4,752g / 7,128g). (3) Rarity never goes down. (4) Essences cannot be sold. (5) Shop-bought items give nothing when dismantled (row 51). (6) Reroll options are fixed (row 55). (7) Enchanted items sell at their STARTING rarity (economy_framework 14), so enchanting never raises sell value.
